usage: Repo should have branch protection with required code reviews
name: CI/CD Bots should not be able to review code changes
description: CI/CD Bots should not be able to review code changes. If the setting is enabled then users can “self-review” by manipulating the pipeline. This means that only one developer’s account needs to be compromised in order to push code in branches that require code reviews.
detailedDescription: Branch protection best practices involve requiring at least one reviewer to review code changes made by a developer. Self-Reviews are typically not allowed.  However, a rather simple bypass is possible if the developer has the ability to access and initiate GitHub Actions.

args.label: Branch protection Requires Reviews
